描述_EN: it is fully lined with fur throughout, being made for cold northern winters, and fur-edged horsehoof cuffs would be revealed when the cuffs were worn turned back. it does not feature the hem border decoration which was typical of dragon's robe. this is a dragon robe made for a woman, possibly for an empress.
描述_ZN: 它的整个内衬都是毛皮，是为北方寒冷的冬天制作的，当袖口向后穿时，毛皮边缘的马蹄形袖口会露出来。 它没有龙袍典型的下摆边框装饰。 这是一件为女性制作的龙袍，可能是为一位皇后制作的。
